g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample the continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Centres closer than1.5mm are omitted at junctions. Broccoli uses its outer contour. Grape berry contours precede stem; duplicate attachment dots are omitted. Strawberry body precedes cap, with exact shared seam sampled only once after distance filtering. All dot alternatives remain within the same shared master. These are design positions, not measured hardware properties.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Broccoli body, grape berries and strawberry body lower grey; black contours and grape stem higher. Strawberry cap interior white unraised. No calibrated-height or material claim.
